payload.title: Evaluate usefulness, acquisition and affiliate experiments
payload.goal: Choose the next evidence-backed path toward legitimate commission rather than treating the first checker release as completion.
payload.owner_role: Designated Windows release parent assigns one admitted implementation owner; separate exact-source reviewer; existing scheduled operator retains integration/effect ownership
implementation_steps: Freeze a baseline and a first measurement-sheet or exact-model-result hypothesis with target audience, intervention, comparator, useful exposure threshold, window and stop rules from current traffic evidence.
Evaluate completed checks, resolved uncertainty, permitted referrals and commission states separately; do not infer revenue from clicks or evaluate affiliate conversion before eligible links.
Select adopt/revert/bounded-extension/stop and justify next source/model/guide/acquisition experiment using expected benefit, effort, uncertainty and allowed route.
Preserve sparse/negative results as inconclusive/not-supported and record confounders; refresh stale source guardrail immediately overrides commercial optimization.

Keep one active mission experiment by pilot default; increase only under noncontamination and existing capacity/authority; after the 90-day horizon create an explicit reviewed continue/change/stop decision rather than an endless unexamined schedule.

Derive the terminal horizon from the existing mission November 21, 2026 local final day. After reviewed continue/change/stop, new external experiment effects require a valid owner charter extension; absent it retain original results, reconcile existing receipts and continue offline source/draft work without silently extending the campaign.
tests: Missing traffic coverage yields unknown or invalidated outcome, not success; no approved commission yields no commercial validation.
New source hazard stops affected referral experiment while independent guide work remains eligible.
Closed protocol yields one next candidate or no-action and repeated evaluation cannot duplicate intervention.

At the original horizon, emit one review decision; without valid charter extension new experiment/referral changes remain paused. Extension preserves original dates, commission windows and review evidence.

review.identity_requirement: Reviewer-authored record with actual reviewer identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model qualification is required for runtime/release acceptance and is not supplied by this plan.
review.exact_source: Bind immutable implementation commit, task/spec hash, artifact hashes, executed test receipts and any destination receipt. New source invalidates prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two targeted repair/review cycles; unresolved findings become a linked blocked task, preserving attempts.

acceptance: Every experiment closes with reviewed evidence and an executable next decision or justified wait.
Repeated cycles progress toward helpful fit and legitimate money while honoring source confidence and permission gates.
Original mission clock is preserved and its end triggers one reviewed horizon decision; post-horizon effects require valid extension authority.
payload.rollback: Stop next effect and restore intervention through existing release owner, retaining observations and protocol amendments.
payload.next_eligible_action: Prepare a measurement-tool versus current-flow protocol from current aggregate baseline and implement sparse-evidence fixtures.

estimate.assumptions: New planning range for admitted implementation and bounded review; reuses evidenced assets; excludes observation waiting, non-delegable account work and shared-platform implementation. Not a replacement for historical Jira estimates or measured actuals.
estimate.dependency_risk: Traffic/commission evidence determines elapsed windows; no arbitrary visitor threshold is fabricated.
